page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at the top. No page number printed.

main_text.p: cundum legem sacrificia ordinavit: cele-brariq; Pascha instituit, quod jampridem2.Par.30. fuerat omissum. Cumque dies festus ad-effe[?] dimissis per omnem terram nunciis,aindixit. Col. conventus diem edixit: ut si qui post ab-ductionem decem tribuum in Samaria re-sedissent, ad solenne sacrum convenirent. Ita frequentissimo conventu dies facer publica laetitia exactus, longo post intervallo religione legitima per Ezechiam re-stituta. Pari deinde industria, qua divina curaverat, rem bellicam administravit,4.Reg 18. Allophiloque frequentibus praeliis con-2.Par.32.tudit: donec ei Sennacherib rex Assyrio-rum bellum intulit, magno cum exercitu fines ejus ingressus: lateque agris vastatis,Esa.36. nullo obsistente, urbis obsidionem urge-bat. Ezechias enim multitudine inferior, non aulus manum conferre[?], muris se tu-ebatur. Rex Assyrius portis alsultans, mi-nitari excidium, deditionem imperare, Ezechiam frustra Deo confidere, se Dei nutu potius armab sump- sse. Sig.[?] {b}supprelsisse: victorem omnium gentium, eversorem Samariae, effugi non posse, ni matura deditione si-bimet consuluissent. In hoc rerum sta-tu Ezechias Deo fretus,Esa.37. Esaiam pro-

page.notes: Running head read as "SVLPICII SEVERI"; the second letter may be a capital L or I, doubtful. The word after "ad-" in line 2 is printed as "effe" with a mark after it; read as "effe[?]", and the printed word is probably "adesset". "alsultans" in line 6 is doubtful (possibly "assultans"). "aulus" is printed as such. The left margin note beside "conventus" is printed as "aindixit. Col.", uncertain. The left margin note with "b" is partly unreadable; the sign "*" beside "fines" in the text column is unclear and not transcribed. The last line ends with "pro-" and the catchword "phetam" at the foot is left out of the text. No page number is printed.
